CustomField.description: How often this expense is recorded. Daily: any number of entries per day. Monthly: one entry per calendar month, saved against the 1st of the month (set by ExpenseEntryTriggerHandler).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Daily = entered day by day (tea, transport). Monthly = one amount per month (rent, salaries); only one entry per month is allowed.
CustomField.label: Type
